integrity: A self-contained all-parameter proof is included. An exact arithmetic script tests finite examples independently; finite calculations are not offered as a proof of the infinite theorem. The prior construction belongs to Kozlov and Snellman.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary coordinate Euclidean geometry of positive-leg shifted right-angle simplex sums only; no facet lattice, inradius, or complete vertex classification is asserted. Historical priority among older orthoscheme results is provisional.
title: Outer-sphere contact transitions in shifted right-angle and Kozlov polytopes
